subject: local copy of MathJax for withMathJax

messages.author: a814dd0eade31e3e
messages.subject: local copy of MathJax for withMathJax
parts:
withMathJax is very nice. I would like to use it even when offline. I cloned the MathJax github repo. However, it seems from the function that the path is fixed? What would need to be inside a shiny app to get the same effect, off line that withMathJax currently produces when online?

> withMathJax
function (...) 
{
    path <- "https://cdn.mathjax.org/mathjax/latest/MathJax.js?config=TeX-AMS-MML_HTMLorMML"
    tagList(tags$head(singleton(tags$script(src = path, type = "text/javascript"))), 
        ..., tags$script(HTML("MathJax.Hub.Queue([\"Typeset\", MathJax.Hub]);")))
}

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: local copy of MathJax for withMathJax
parts: I think you could copy the entire MathJax repo (minus the .git directory) right into your Shiny app under the www/ directory. Then make your own version of withMathJax but replace the path with "MathJax/MathJax.js?config=TeX-AMS-MML_HTMLorMML".
